requirement: A new EmDash site gets its mail path through the Tracy relay, or the provision refuses to mark it ready

oracle.ref: PR #827 (fix); fix evidence: Issue #803 (source-confirmed, runtime-unverified): no provision step selected a mail provider. Before the fix the ten `mail (generic|business)` cases of emdash-post-up.test.mjs fail and emdash-mail.test.mjs cannot load its helper.
oracle.invariant: The run exits 0 and its summary reads `fail 0`. emdash-mail.test.mjs: `an unconfigured site gets phpmail, the sender and the exclusive hook, then a readback` passes. emdash-post-up.test.mjs: `mail (generic): configured after the token is stored and before ready, PAT off argv` and the same line for `mail (business)` pass. emdash-post-up.test.mjs: `mail (generic): no shim, no relay variables, another label or a failed exec FAILS before the helper` and the same line for `mail (business)` pass. emdash-post-up.test.mjs: `mail (demo through provision.sh): a framed demo is configured, and one without the shim still FAILS` and `mail (demo through deploy-quickstart.sh): no mail step on that road, and it says the demo mails nobody` pass.
